label: Silly
feel: Toon low-poly in pastel colours under bright light, with soft jelly bodies that flop and tumble. Nothing hurts for long and everything bounces.

alternates.why: crisper ink lines and saturated colour, for a louder party
softer light and deep shade, for a cosier day out

bodies.notes: One tinted body each; a knock ragdolls and gets up (gf-humanoid-1 knockdown and getup).

audio.character: bouncy and bright: short synth blips pitched up, no reverb tails, a light wind bed

mechanics.why: physical comedy: pushing, carrying and grabbing read best with floppy bodies. Suggestions only; the loop decides play.

evidence.what: party games on jelly-pastel, toon-lowpoly and soft-stylised pass verify (the kit examples and the delivered corpus)
the look judge's contact sheet for silly, rendered on the graphics card (its only check)
